slides.slide_title: Introduce /ð/ — mirror work mandatory (5 minutes minimum)
slides.teacher_cue: New sound — voiced th. HIGHEST PRIORITY KOREAN INTERFERENCE. Same tongue position as voiceless /θ/ — tip between teeth — but add voicing. Hand on throat: /θ/ no vibration, /ð/ vibrates. Korean substitutes /d/ — 'dis' for 'this', 'dat' for 'that'. This affects the most common English words. Mandatory 5-minute mirror session: alternate θ-ð-θ-ð, students confirm voicing switch with hand on throat.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /ð/ with tongue tip between teeth, continuous airflow, and throat vibration.
slides.correction_move: Mirror session: produce /θ/ — no vibration. Produce /ð/ — vibration. Alternate. Students hold hand on throat to feel the switch. Then apply to words: thin (/θ/) vs this (/ð/).
slides.observation_note: Watch for /d/ substitution throughout. Note: from this lesson 'with' is now fully decodable — w+i+th(/ð/). Acknowledge the upgrade from sight word to decodable.

content_payload.correction_routine: Feel the throat. this has voiced /ð/; thin has voiceless /θ/.

slides.teacher_cue: Play both words. Students choose the voiced th word and check voicing with a hand on the throat.
slides.expected_response: Students identify this as voiced th and contrast it with thin.
slides.correction_move: Alternate thin/this orally until students can feel the voicing switch and place the tongue correctly.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students who still collapse both th sounds into one category.

content_payload.correction_routine: that begins with /ð/; think begins with /θ/.

slides.teacher_cue: Play both words. Ask students to choose the voiced th word and explain how they know.
slides.expected_response: Students identify that as voiced th and reject think as voiceless th.
slides.correction_move: Contrast the pair with mirror work and repeated listening if students still default to /d/ or /θ/.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can maintain the contrast in connected speech, not just isolated sounds.

slides.teacher_cue: Say this — near demonstrative. Point to something nearby. Confirm /ð/ onset. Reveal print and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say this orally and connect meaning before blending on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model this orally again, then reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /d/ substitution. Redirect with tongue-between-teeth and throat vibration check.

slides.correction_move: Model that orally again, then reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /d/ at onset and for short /æ/ vowel.

slides.correction_move: Model them orally again, then reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /d/ substitution and for the short /e/ vowel.
